title: Kneeling in Pink Paris
description: A woman in an elaborate pink and black dress with matching boots kneels on a stone plaza, holding a rosary and looking down. Behind her stands a large pink gothic cathedral, while an oversized stained glass window arches above showing the same woman in a different pose against a blue and gold background. A surreal Parisian street with cafes and a domed building extends into the distance under a sunset sky.
